credits.title: Prey
credits.overview: A young couple is compelled to leave their Christian missionary station in the Kalahari Desert after being threatened with death by an extremist militant gang. After crashing their aircraft they must battle man and beast for their lives.

credits.title: Carcass
credits.overview: Gabriel is an outcast from society forced to serve as executioner after being branded a thief. When Travis, a young street urchin, is arrested, Gabriel is forced to examine his role in the system. Will he be able to break the cycle and save Travis or meet the fate that all those branded face?
